structured.answer: Harel's S&P 500 tracker is in almost every product, and it shows about 13.7% a year over 3 years and 11.9% over 5 years for a fee of around 0.5%. That's the one I'd go for, but I couldn't tell which product to put it in (קופת גמל להשקעה, my קרן השתלמות, or the cheaper-looking קרן מחקה), so I'm not doing anything today.

stuck.why: First big shekel number. For a second I thought it was about returns or my money, then saw it's 'כסף מנוהל' (the money in the fund)
Two fees per row, 0.16% on the money and 1.47% on 'ההפקדה'. I didn't understand the second one
Dozens of rows that look alike, the same track names repeated in every product. I got bored and scrolled through just reading headings
Fees are split into 'קבוע / משתנה / נאמן' and there are no returns, so I couldn't compare them with the other S&P 500 tracks
Many rows just say 'פחות מ־3 שנים' with no number

findings.what: Too many similar rows (96 tracks), with the same names repeated in every product and no hint which one fits a regular person
Two fees per row ('מהחיסכון' / 'ההפקדה') with no explanation, and 0% and 'אין' mixed together
findings.where: Fee column, especially the pension sections

findings.what: The S&P 500 tracker in the ETF tables shows a fee in a different format (קבוע/משתנה/נאמן) and no return, so it can't be compared with the S&P 500 track in the other products
The first big shekel number is the fund's size (106 מיליון ₪), which is easy to mistake for something that matters to me
Many rows have only 'פחות מ־3 שנים' with no return
The rings show two percentages that add up to more than 100, and I guessed at what they mean
